summary.text: At a glance: AKER BP ASA is a public limited company (ASA) in Bærum, working in utvinning av råolje; 3,127 registered employees and operating revenue USD 10,943,000,000 in 2025, down 12% on 2024; website https://www.akerbp.com.

What's new (past 12 months, newest first): 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 3127; 2026-10-08 board registration changed (chair: Øyvind Eriksen); 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 3104; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 3131; 2026-07-15 employee count updated: 3145; 2026-06-25 annual accounts filed: 2025 (operating revenue down 12% on 2024); +22 more.
AKER BP ASA (org. no. 989795848): Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2006-05-02.

What it does: Primary industry: 06.100 Utvinning av råolje. Registered purpose: Petroleumsleting og -utvinning og hva som dermed står i forbindelse samt ved aksjetegning eller på annen måte å delta i slik eller annen virksomhet alene eller i samarbeid med andre foretagender og interesser.
Business address: Oksenøyveien 10, 1366 LYSAKER, Norge (BÆRUM municipality).
Size: 3,127 registered employees; latest filed company accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31): operating revenue USD 10,943,000,000, annual result USD 133,000,000.
People: CEO (daglig leder): Karl Johnny Hersvik; board chair: Øyvind Eriksen; 12 other board members; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
Locations: 200 active sub-units registered (incl. HARSTAD, LYSAKER, SANDNESSJØEN, STAVANGER, TRONDHEIM).
Status: no bankruptcy, liquidation or forced-dissolution flags registered.
Identity: share capital NOK 632,022,210 (registered 2022-06-30); formerly registered as DET NORSKE OLJESELSKAP ASA (until 2016-09-30), AKER EXPLORATION ASA (until 2009-12-22).
Website: https://www.akerbp.com (as registered, and verified on the site).
Company-owned profiles linked from its website: https://facebook.com/akerbpasa, https://instagram.com/akerbp, https://linkedin.com/company/akerbp.
Hiring: no active job ads on arbeidsplassen.no (NAV) for this company or its sub-units.
Recent registry activity: 2026-10-13 employee count updated: 3127; 2026-09-14 employee count updated: 3104; 2026-08-12 employee count updated: 3131 (15 events since 2025).
Changes: none since the previous check on 2026-11-06.
Unknown or not published: job postings (none active on NAV).
